## PinInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The code. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled. Length is padded or trimmed to `length`.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new code whenever a cell changes.
- `onComplete` :: Called once when every cell is filled.
- `length` :: How many cells to show.
- `charset` :: `numeric` accepts digits only; `alphanumeric` accepts letters and digits.
- `mask` :: Hides the characters, as a password field would.
- `size` :: The cell height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the cell height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of each cell. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered cell, `filled` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the group invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the cells.
